question: Under what condition is this knowledge placed under an obligation to be taken, and with what degree of exertion is that obligation to be fulfilled?
premises: The object is something to be taken.
It is to be taken with effort.
This obligation falls to one who desires accomplishment within the Kaula path.
inference: One who desires accomplishment in the Kaula path must take this knowledge up with effort.
uncertainties: The antecedent of the gerundive is not repeated in this verse and must come from verse 379.
plain_english: It must be taken with effort in the Kaula path by one who desires accomplishment.
